report.speaker: Benoit Pausader
report.title: Stability Problems in Collisionless Kinetic Systems
report.question: 参考轨道从自由流变为等离子体波和陷获轨道时，怎样确定宏观场的衰减、终态及稳定性的正确含义？

4H08.scope: 在指定范数中定义线性控制、指数模态及轨道稳定目标。

4H09.scope: y=x-tv 换元给 L1_x Linfty_v 到 Linfty_x 的 t^-d 界。

4H0A.scope: 对两个 Schwartz 函数 phi、chi 两次分部积分，分别给空间 Linfty 和 L1 界；不额外要求紧支撑。

4H0B.scope: 链式法则给精确轮廓方程；线性反应项和非线性项分别保留。

4H0C.scope: 近处 R Linfty 与远处 R^-2 L1 分裂后优化半径。

4H0D.scope: 支配收敛与奇核截断证明自由模型极限；不附加 Schwartz 假设到研究定理。

4H0E.scope: 从精确轨道展开 At^-2+O(t^-2-delta) 两次积分；仅有 O(t^-2) 界不够。

4H0F.scope: 报告二阶联合权小量版本；原论文 Thm1.1(i)/3.1 的 weighted gamma 解类与局部时间正则性，局部一致收敛；不声称一般弱解唯一。

4H0G.scope: 精确保留空间第五阶权、一阶与二阶导数权及场 W3infty；给出 Thm4.2 sigma 终态类。终态只要求有限，不要求小。

4H0H.scope: 第五阶联合权与导数空间权、小量及 W3infty 场；正负时间对数平移号相反。

4H0I.scope: 假设 C1 反解存在，用 d²S=0 证明保辛与 Hamilton–Jacobi 直化；不证明全局坐标存在。

4H0J.scope: 正能量给半径下界，二阶径向凸性给线性逃逸，积分加速度得两端速度。

4H0K.scope: 假设 H=a²/2 的正则坐标存在，计算 SIC 量及约束；不重建全局 Kepler 散射坐标。

4H0L.scope: 外法向入流零，Stokes 通量恒等式；无界域附加外截断通量趋零，区分镜面反射。

4H0M.scope: 有界域、半空间、圆柱的 blowdown 必要条件；不是充分的散射定理。

4H0N.scope: 单位质量背景与环面 Poisson 中性相容。三维紧支撑非中性密度仍给 O(|x|^-2) 场；一维 E(+infty)-E(-infty)=Q 排除非零总量时的双端趋零。

4H0O.scope: Fourier 模态积分因子求解，频率分母零处取连续极限 t。

4H0P.scope: Duhamel 公式和速度分部积分，准确保持卷积号及非线性迫项的角色。

4H0Q.scope: 定义指定频率集合上的下界，证明已存在因果解的加权 L2 乘子界；不由代数除法推出因果逆核。

4H0R.scope: K(0,theta)=-theta^-2 与两步极限给非零小频率反例；不适用于环面整数频率。

4H0S.scope: 三维质量积分与径向逆 Fourier 积分；测试函数证明变换身份。报告 a=sqrt2、primary a=1。

4H0T.scope: 独立证明 k*q=k-q，以卷积结合律验证因果响应核 delta_0-1_{t>=0}exp(-a|xi|t)sin(t)，用阶乘迭代证明唯一性；衰减因子为 exp(-a|xi|t)。

4H0U.scope: 精确速度幂尾下 gamma>2 收敛、gamma=2 对数发散；含对数修正的尾需另外判别。

4H0V.scope: primary v2 C1 小数据速度权9/2，两类混合范数，无中性假设；静态3-delta、振荡2-delta、散射1/2，delta=10^-4。

4H0W.scope: a 与 a' 的明确衰减假设下分部积分得到 T^-1+delta 尾界。

4H0X.scope: 位置离散频率、速度连续频率、速度矩和指数半径；与 Euler Gevrey 不等同。

4H0Y.scope: rhohat(t,k)=fhat0(k,tk)，在明确逐点指数频率界下得到时间衰减，不直接把积分范数当逐点界。

remaining_branches.branch: Large data, optimal topology and low dimensions
remaining_branches.scope: 4H1H/4H1I represent report§6 questions1–3 as open or conditional. No large-initial-data scattering or two-dimensional asymptotic framework proved.

4H0J/0K prove reference-flow facts only. Full self-consistent repulsive-charge stability theorem, convex absorbing-domain nonlinear scattering and attractive point-mass trapped dynamics are not reconstructed; boundary problem beyond torus remains open context.

The exact Poisson model and Gevrey torus theorem are covered. General linear spectral decomposition for arbitrary tails is not fully stated or proved. Survey ref4 thick-tail extension through gamma=2 remains in preparation, not an available proof; thin-tail nonlinear damping is an open question in the survey.

Same-minimal-period linear result only. General tangent-completion geometry, all higher compatibility functionals, Fprime(0)=0, non-global-energy states, other periods, nonlinear modulation and unstable-orbit endpoints remain unexpanded.

Moment and Schrodinger–Poisson definitions, screening and relativistic low-frequency computation are included. Full Vlasov–Maxwell magnetic-wave theory, quantum analogues, rigorous quasilinear modulation and high-dimensional confined BGK classification are not developed. These match report§6 questions8–11 context.

unexpanded_deep_proofs.scope: Nonlinear characteristic bootstrap, weighted derivative propagation, convergence of the asymptotic field, singular-time wave-operator contraction and global extension cited. Source classes now specified; no uniqueness for arbitrary weak solutions.
Nonlinear resonant field decomposition, all §§3–7 estimates and §8 closure not reproduced.
Endpoint Gevrey nonlinear bootstrap, echo chains, causal response estimates, final-state construction and scattering injectivity proofs cited.

Bifurcation tangent theorem, operator-valued dielectric expansion, small eigenvalue analysis, modulation projections and time-integrated damping proof cited. Local pendulum geometry is not a proof of the stability sign criterion.
Elementary energy/Abel identities proved locally; full smooth BGK manifold parametrization and all endpoint compatibility/positivity conditions are not reproduced.
